      tmux capture-pane -t "$PANE" -p 2>/dev/null | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*[mGKHFJA-Z]//g' | grep -E '^\s*❯' | tail -1
      echo ""
      echo "files: $(wc -l < /tmp/eq3-003b-claude-empty.txt) + $(wc -l < /tmp/eq3-003b-claude-typing.txt) lines")
